prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, paid media, branding, B2B vs B2C, creative/video, etc.), your budget, industry, and whether you want a local partner or are fine with a remote shop.

To help you find the best fit, tell me:
- What are your top goals (lead generation, brand awareness, growth, e‑commerce sales, hires, etc.)?
- Which services do you need (SEO, PPC, social media, content, branding, web design, email, PR, video)?
- Your monthly/annual budget range.
- Company size and industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; healthcare, finance, construction, retail…).
- Preference for an agency with a Maryland office or is remote OK?
- Timeline (ongoing, 3–6 month campaign, one-off project)?

If you want to start researching on your own, use these steps and resources:
- Directories/review sites: Clutch.co, The Manifest, UpCity — filter by Maryland and the service you need.
- Local recognition: Baltimore Business Journal “Best Places to Work”/agency lists, Maryland Chamber awards.
- Check case studies and metrics (not just visuals): look for measurable results relevant to your goals.
- Read client reviews and ask for 2–3 client references (similar industry and company size).
- Evaluate process and communication style — ask to see a sample strategy and reporting cadence.

Sample questions to ask agencies:
- Can you show results for clients with goals similar to ours? (metrics, timeframe)
- What would you do in the first 90 days? What’s your reporting cadence?
- Who will do the work (team structure) and who will be my day-to-day contact?
- What tools do you use for analytics/advertising/automation?
- How do you measure ROI and attribute leads/sales?

If you provide the details above, I can shortlist 3–5 Maryland agencies that fit your needs (with pros/cons for each) or draft an RFP you can send to agencies. Which would you prefer?
